description: This file contains unit tests for the OverallStatusRoute class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests various API endpoints related to overall system status, health, and cluster status, ensuring proper authentication handling and response codes.

classes.name: OverallStatusRouteTest
classes.description: Unit test class for OverallStatusRoute, testing API endpoints for overall status, health, and cluster information with various authentication scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test route with a mocked cluster status supplier and health provider before each test.

methods.name: getOverallStatusWithAuth
methods.description: Tests fetching overall status with proper authentication, expecting success status code.

methods.name: getOverallStatusWithoutAuth
methods.description: Tests fetching overall status without authentication, expecting UNAUTHORIZED.

methods.name: getOverallStatusHealthWithAuth
methods.description: Tests fetching overall health with proper authentication, expecting success status code.

methods.name: getOverallStatusHealthWithoutAuth
methods.description: Tests fetching overall health without authentication, expecting UNAUTHORIZED.

methods.name: getOverallStatusClusterWithAuth
methods.description: Tests fetching cluster status with proper authentication, expecting success status code.

methods.name: getOverallStatusClusterAsStatusUser
methods.description: Tests fetching cluster status as a status user with credentials, expecting success.

methods.name: getOverallStatusClusterWithoutAuth
methods.description: Tests fetching cluster status without authentication, expecting UNAUTHORIZED.

methods.name: getNonExistingToplevelUrl
methods.description: Tests accessing an invalid URL, expecting NOT_FOUND.
